summary: At the cited source, BrowserComposition.options derives PublicOrigin directly from config.ListenUrl, while BrowserEndpoints hostMatches compares the request Host with PublicOrigin.Authority. A wildcard listen address or a container port distinct from the public origin therefore cannot represent the browser origin. Port publication and browser host filtering must be joined explicitly. Diagnosis should inspect the actual configured origin and Host before interpreting missing dashboard assets as a packaging defect. A source repair or local configuration proposal establishes no deployed receiver change, authenticated browser journey or lifecycle acceptance; those require their own observed readback. The implementation finding is owned by Telemetry.Host issue4877 and the receiver journey by4707.
title: Browser public origin and server listen address have separate identities
